script: This video was made by one command. [pause 0.5] I wrote the script. ScriptVox read it aloud, cut my own clips on the rhythm of my voice, and wrote captions that fit the screen. [pause 0.5] It checked every frame before it gave me the file. It never spent a cent I did not approve. And if my laptop had crashed, it would have picked up where it stopped. [pause 0.5] ScriptVox.
